description.value:
You reach into a creature you can see within range and pull at its willpower. Make a ranged force attack against it; on a hit, the target takes 2d6 necrotic damage, and until the power ends its Strength-based weapon attacks deal only half damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target may attempt a Constitution saving throw, ending the power on a success.

Casting this power with a force slot of 3rd level or higher increases the damage by 1d6 for each slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 2
